name: Cup close-up with steam
summary: A close, slow push towards your drink as steam rises.
outcome: A close shot of your drink with a slow push towards it, steam rising and light shifting across the surface of the coffee.
photoGuidance: A close photo of one drink, filling most of the frame.
limitations: Text and logos in your photo may change in the video. Check the result before you post it.

inputs.label: Your drink
inputs.help: For example, 'flat white in a white ceramic cup'.
inputs.example: Flat white in a white ceramic cup

options.label: Daylight
options.prompt: Soft natural daylight from the side.

options.label: Warm indoor light
options.prompt: Warm indoor light with soft shadows.

inputs.label: Details to keep as they are
inputs.help: Optional. For example, the colour of your cups or the shape of a sign.

inputs.label: Anything to leave out
inputs.help: Optional. For example, no smoke or no people.

prompt.preserve: Keep everything in the photo recognisable: the same objects, shapes, colours and proportions. Keep any printed text, labels and logos as they are.
prompt.avoid: Do not add people, hands, text, captions, logos or new objects. No sudden cuts, no camera shake, no warping or melting of surfaces.
prompt.subject: The photo shows {subject}, close up.
prompt.composition: The cup stays centred and fills most of the frame.
prompt.environment: The background stays as in the photo, softly out of focus.
prompt.camera: The camera pushes in very slowly towards the cup.
prompt.subjectMotion: Steam rises gently from the drink. The surface of the coffee and any latte art stay as they are.
